description.zh:
629 年至 645 年，唐代高僧玄奘从长安出发，经河西走廊、西域、中亚进入印度，在那烂陀寺求学五年，巡礼五印度，后携六百五十七部梵本佛经归国。

> 据《大唐西域记》《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》编年；争议年代（曲女城大会、那烂陀入学）取通行一说，均属研究推定；路线为示意简化。
description.en:
From 629 to 645 the Tang monk Xuanzang traveled from Chang’an through the Hexi Corridor, the Western Regions and Central Asia to India, studied for five years at Nalanda, pilgrimaged across the five Indias, and returned with 657 Sanskrit manuscripts.

> Chronology follows the Records of the Western Regions and the Biography of the Tripitaka Master; disputed dates are given as scholarly estimates and routes are schematic.

description.zh: 唐代高僧，西行求法十七年。
description.en: A Tang dynasty monk who traveled west for seventeen years in search of Buddhist scriptures.
